svg.content: <mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" pages="2" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Dispute engine flow" id="hOU-uG_r811U7Y4zHVSi"> <mxGraphModel dx="2550" dy="830" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1250" pageHeight="1800" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="ftitle" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=18;fontColor=#1E2761;" value="<b>Dispute engine — end-to-end flow</b><br>Coral-bordered boxes were missing from the whiteboard sketch" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="700" x="40" y="10" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="clocks" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#F96167;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#3A4470;align=left;spacing=10;fontSize=11;verticalAlign=top;" value="<b>CLOCKS — ADDED</b><br><br>Reg E — provisional credit in 10 business days; resolve in 45 / 90 days<br><br>Card networks — per reason code, per lifecycle state<br><br>RBI — turnaround time on domestic rails<br><br>Internal SLA — per stage, per queue<br><br><i>Clocks run across every stage. A breach escalates before it happens, not after.</i>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="330" width="260" x="40" y="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="feedback" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#1E2761;strokeColor=#1E2761;fontColor=#CADCFC;align=left;spacing=10;fontSize=11;verticalAlign=top;" value="<b>FEEDBACK LOOP</b><br><br>Reopen · Representment · Arbitration return the case to Investigation with its evidence intact.<br><br>Every customer reply files against the open ask — nothing is retyped." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="180" width="260" x="40" y="440" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="actors" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#1E2761;strokeColor=#1E2761;fontColor=#CADCFC;align=left;spacing=10;fontSize=11;" value="<b>Actors &amp; channels</b><br>Customer · Merchant · Dispute manager · Ops · Auditor — via App · Web · Branch · Call centre · Email" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="560" x="380" y="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="prevention" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#F96167;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#3A4470;align=left;spacing=10;fontSize=11;" value="<b>Prevention gate — ADDED</b><br>Show the receipt first: "Is this it?" Confusion cases end here (40–45% in market data). The dispute button moves to second place." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="560" x="380" y="190" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="generate" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#CADCFC;strokeColor=#1E2761;fontColor=#1E2761;align=left;spacing=10;fontSize=11;" value="<b>Dispute generate</b><br>Customer evidence: date, amount, description, transaction id, invoice, image. Conversational intake files the story as structured evidence.<br><i>ADDED: one case can cover many transactions — a recurring merchant, a stolen card.</i>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="560" x="380" y="310" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="abuse" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#F96167;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#3A4470;align=left;spacing=10;fontSize=11;" value="<b>Abuse controls — ADDED</b>&nbsp;&nbsp; duplicate case check · velocity limits · repeat-disputer flag" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="560" x="380" y="450" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="reason" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#F96167;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#3A4470;align=left;spacing=10;fontSize=11;" value="<b>Reason code &amp; liability — ADDED</b><br>Map the story to a reason code — fraud (10.4) or service (13.1 / 13.3 / 12.6). Apply the 3DS liability shift. This step decides the deadlines, the permitted evidence, and who carries the loss." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="560" x="380" y="540" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="matrix" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#CADCFC;strokeColor=#1E2761;fontColor=#1E2761;align=left;spacing=10;fontSize=11;" value="<b>Investigation matrix</b><br>Level 1 — Customer + Bank<br>Level 2 — Customer + Bank + Merchant<br>Level 3 — Customer + Bank + Merchant + Network<br><i>The party list per level comes from the domain pack, not from code.</i>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="560" x="380" y="670" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="d360" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#CADCFC;strokeColor=#1E2761;fontColor=#1E2761;align=left;spacing=10;fontSize=11;" value="<b>Dispute 360° — event reconstruction</b><br>Authorisation, clearing, evidence and messages joined on one timeline. The dashboard updates as facts arrive." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="560" x="380" y="820" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="decision" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#CADCFC;strokeColor=#1E2761;fontColor=#1E2761;align=left;spacing=10;fontSize=11;" value="<b>Decision</b><br>1. Rulebook check — scheme rules plugged in from the domain pack<br>2. Straight-through cases — inside approval thresholds, executed and logged<br>3. Scored cases — a confidence score with its basis on record<br>4. People decide the rest — maker-checker on every override" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="560" x="380" y="930" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="action" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#CADCFC;strokeColor=#1E2761;fontColor=#1E2761;align=left;spacing=10;fontSize=11;" value="<b>Action</b><br>Smart assignment — queue, skills, capacity — routes the case to a dispute manager. Allowed straight-through cases execute directly, with the full trail kept." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="560" x="380" y="1090" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="money" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#F96167;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#3A4470;align=left;spacing=10;fontSize=11;" value="<b>Money movement — ADDED</b><br>Provisional credit in and out · write-off · recovery · ledger posting and reversal. Every movement runs once, is reconciled against the ledger, and can be traced." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="560" x="380" y="1210" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="letters" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#F96167;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#3A4470;align=left;spacing=10;fontSize=11;" value="<b>Correspondence — ADDED</b><br>Written notices at the moments the law fixes (Reg E), merchant queries, closure letters. Templates come from the domain pack; every letter lands in the audit trail." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="560" x="380" y="1330" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="closure" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#CADCFC;strokeColor=#1E2761;fontColor=#1E2761;align=left;spacing=10;fontSize=11;" value="<b>Resolution &amp; closure</b><br>Gated close: evidence complete, clocks satisfied, approvals in place. The customer gets the answer in plain words, in their own view." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="560" x="380" y="1450" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="smtitle" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=13;fontColor=#1E2761;" value="<b>The network state machine — ADDED</b>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="30" width="400" x="200" y="1580" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="st1" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#CADCFC;strokeColor=#1E2761;fontColor=#1E2761;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" value="Retrieval request" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="150" x="200" y="1620" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="st2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#CADCFC;strokeColor=#1E2761;fontColor=#1E2761;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" value="First chargeback" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="150" x="390" y="1620" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="st3" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#CADCFC;strokeColor=#1E2761;fontColor=#1E2761;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" value="Representment" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="150" x="580" y="1620" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="st4" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#CADCFC;strokeColor=#1E2761;fontColor=#1E2761;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" value="Pre-arbitration" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="150" x="770" y="1620" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="st5" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#CADCFC;strokeColor=#1E2761;fontColor=#1E2761;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" value="Arbitration" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="150" x="960" y="1620" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="smnote" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=10;fontColor=#3A4470;" value="Each state has its own clock, message format and permitted evidence. Other domains plug in their own state list — UDIR steps for UPI, claim stages for warranty and insurance." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="910" x="200" y="1670" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=18;fontColor=#1E2761;" value="<b>Dispute engine — AI agents by layer</b><br>Blue = language-model agent · White = plain rules (not a model) style="swimlane;horizontal=0;html=1;startSize=36;fillColor=#F5F7FF;strokeColor=#1E2761;fontColor=#1E2761;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;rounded=0;" value="Customer channel" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="180" width="1250" x="40" y="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="intake" parent="lane1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#CADCFC;strokeColor=#1E2761;fontColor=#1E2761;align=left;spacing=8;fontSize=11;" value="<b>Intake agent</b> (LLM)<br><i>Soul: a patient teller — never invents a fact</i><br>Skills: read the story · ask the missing fact · structured output<br>Task: turn "I don't know this charge" into date, amount, merchant, claim type" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="360" x="60" y="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="statuschat" parent="lane1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#CADCFC;strokeColor=#1E2761;fontColor=#1E2761;align=left;spacing=8;fontSize=11;" value="<b>Status chat agent</b> (LLM)<br><i>Soul: a plain-speaking clerk — answers only from the customer's own view</i><br>Skills: grounded answers · fixed stage words<br>Task: "where is my case?" without exposing bank-side notes" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="360" x="450" y="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="router" parent="lane1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#3A4470;fontColor=#3A4470;align=left;spacing=8;fontSize=11;" value="<b>Reply router</b> — NOT A MODEL<br>A plain rule decides: questions go to the chat agent; statements file as evidence against the open ask." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="360" x="840" y="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lane2" parent="1" style="swimlane;horizontal=0;html=1;startSize=36;fillColor=#F5F7FF;strokeColor=#1E2761;fontColor=#1E2761;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;rounded=0;" value="Evidence" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="180" width="1250" x="40" y="300" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="slipreader" parent="lane2" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#CADCFC;strokeColor=#1E2761;fontColor=#1E2761;align=left;spacing=8;fontSize=11;" value="<b>Slip reader agent</b> (LLM)<br><i>Soul: a forms clerk — reads what is there, flags what it cannot read</i><br>Skills: read slip images · structured fields<br>Task: merchant, date, amount, last four — into the evidence store" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="360" x="60" y="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="matcher" parent="lane2" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#3A4470;fontColor=#3A4470;align=left;spacing=8;fontSize=11;" value="<b>Tiered matcher</b> — NOT A MODEL<br>Exact keys, tried in tiers. Attach only on a certain match; when unsure, attach nothing and ask a person." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="360" x="450" y="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ranker" parent="lane2" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#3A4470;fontColor=#3A4470;align=left;spacing=8;fontSize=11;" value="<b>Evidence ranker</b> — NOT A MODEL<br>Impact × supply × fit. Names the next best evidence and which party holds it." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="360" x="840" y="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lane3" parent="1" style="swimlane;horizontal=0;html=1;startSize=36;fillColor=#F5F7FF;strokeColor=#1E2761;fontColor=#1E2761;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;rounded=0;" value="Case work" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="180" width="1250" x="40" y="500" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="planner" parent="lane3" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#CADCFC;strokeColor=#1E2761;fontColor=#1E2761;align=left;spacing=8;fontSize=11;" value="<b>Case planner agent</b> (LLM)<br><i>Soul: a senior case officer — states the next step and why, in writing</i><br>Skills: read the whole case · write the next step<br>Task: the rationale lands in the audit trail, capped and attributed" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="360" x="60" y="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="advocates" parent="lane3" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#CADCFC;strokeColor=#1E2761;fontColor=#1E2761;align=left;spacing=8;fontSize=11;" value="<b>Advocates — two agents</b> (LLM)<br><i>Soul: opposing counsel — one argues the bank's side, one the merchant's</i><br>Skills: argue both sides · cite the evidence<br>Task: a decision-ready dossier with both cases made, before a person rules" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="360" x="450" y="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lane4" parent="1" style="swimlane;horizontal=0;html=1;startSize=36;fillColor=#F5F7FF;strokeColor=#1E2761;fontColor=#1E2761;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;rounded=0;" value="Decision & control" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="180" width="1250" x="40" y="700" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="score" parent="lane4" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#3A4470;fontColor=#3A4470;align=left;spacing=8;fontSize=11;" value="<b>Confidence score</b> — NO LANGUAGE MODEL<br>A small statistical score with its basis on record; a fixed formula the auditor can re-run. Routes cases to straight-through or to people." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="360" x="60" y="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="makerchecker" parent="lane4" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#F96167;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#3A4470;align=left;spacing=8;fontSize=11;" value="<b>Maker-checker</b> — PEOPLE<br>Four eyes on every approval, every override, every rulebook change. Agents propose; people confirm." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="360" x="450" y="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="rulebook" parent="lane4" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#3A4470;fontColor=#3A4470;align=left;spacing=8;fontSize=11;" value="<b>Domain rulebook</b> — CONFIG<br>Scheme rules, clocks and thresholds as configuration from the domain pack. A rule release is a config change, not a deployment." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="360" x="840" y="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="guardrails" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#1E2761;strokeColor=#1E2761;fontColor=#CADCFC;align=left;spacing=12;fontSize=11;" value="<b>Guardrails on every agent:</b> every run is durable (queued · running · complete · refused · cancelled) — a refusal flags the case, nothing is silently dropped · instructions are content-stamped so the audit shows exactly what each agent was told · no model ever decides an attach or moves money · every AI-written sentence in a case file carries its basis." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="1250" x="40" y="900" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> div.div:
CLOCKS — ADDED
Reg E — provisional credit in 10 business days; resolve in 45 / 90 days
Card networks — per reason code, per lifecycle state
RBI — turnaround time on domestic rails
Internal SLA — per stage, per queue
Clocks run across every stage. A breach escalates before it happens, not after.

div.div:
FEEDBACK LOOP
Reopen · Representment · Arbitration return the case to Investigation with its evidence intact.
Every customer reply files against the open ask — nothing is retyped.

Customer · Merchant · Dispute manager · Ops · Auditor — via App · Web · Branch · Call centre · Email

Prevention gate — ADDED
Show the receipt first: "Is this it?" Confusion cases end here (40–45% in market data). The dispute button moves to second place.

div.div:
Dispute generate
Customer evidence: date, amount, description, transaction id, invoice, image. Conversational intake files the story as structured evidence.
ADDED: one case can cover many transactions — a recurring merchant, a stolen card.

div.div:
Reason code & liability — ADDED
Map the story to a reason code — fraud (10.4) or service (13.1 / 13.3 / 12.6). Apply the 3DS liability shift. This step decides the deadlines, the permitted evidence, and who carries the loss.

Investigation matrix
Level 1 — Customer + Bank
Level 2 — Customer + Bank + Merchant
Level 3 — Customer + Bank + Merchant + Network
The party list per level comes from the domain pack, not from code.

Dispute 360° — event reconstruction
Authorisation, clearing, evidence and messages joined on one timeline. The dashboard updates as facts arrive.

div.div:
Decision
1. Rulebook check — scheme rules plugged in from the domain pack
2. Straight-through cases — inside approval thresholds, executed and logged
3. Scored cases — a confidence score with its basis on record
4. People decide the rest — maker-checker on every override

Action
Smart assignment — queue, skills, capacity — routes the case to a dispute manager. Allowed straight-through cases execute directly, with the full trail kept.

div.div:
Money movement — ADDED
Provisional credit in and out · write-off · recovery · ledger posting and reversal. Every movement runs once, is reconciled against the ledger, and can be traced.

div.div:
Correspondence — ADDED
Written notices at the moments the law fixes (Reg E), merchant queries, closure letters. Templates come from the domain pack; every letter lands in the audit trail.

Gated close: evidence complete, clocks satisfied, approvals in place. The customer gets the answer in plain words, in their own view.
